abc.title: ABC
abc.text: Let's say the ABC! A is for Apple. B is for Ball. C is for Cat. D is for Duck. E is for Elephant. F is for Fish. G is for Goat. H is for Hat. I is for Ice cream. J is for Juice. K is for Kite. L is for Lion. M is for Moon. N is for Nest. O is for Orange. P is for Parrot. Q is for Queen. R is for Rabbit. S is for Sun. T is for Tree. U is for Umbrella. V is for Van. W is for Water. X is for Xylophone. Y is for Yo-yo. Z is for Zebra. Well done!

numbers.title: Counting
numbers.text: Let's count together! One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten. Great counting!
